title: Accessibility | Apple Developer Documentation - [Cognitive](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility\#Cognitive)
claim: Be cautious with fast-moving and blinking animations.** When you use these effects in excess, it can be distracting, cause dizziness, and in some cases even result in epileptic episodes. People who are prone to these effects can turn on the Reduce Motion accessibility setting. When this setting is active, ensure your app or game responds by reducing automatic and repetitive animations, including zooming, scaling, and peripheral motion.
